position_contract: Recipient and donor selector must have identical absolute token position. Actual post-gating MLP and normalized/rotated K/V values come from unmodified donor forwards. No averaged or fitted vectors.
application: Use capture_selector on each caller-supplied prompt, then selector_site with the actual donor dictionary and the declared kind. MLP changes prefill only; K/V changes shared reads each cached step. Context exit restores hooks and verifies native parameter versions.
validation: All 200 original GPU outputs and host audit passed. Forty individual self hashes, twenty joint self generations and twenty restorations were exact. K/V producer-output and native-cache value guards passed. No independent clean-package pretrained replay is claimed.
scope: Saves exact mechanisms and fixed policies. Raw prompts and donor activation traces are private. No base weights are duplicated. This is a conditional inference policy, not a trained model checkpoint.
result_limit: Joint opposite-policy MLP donor control transferred sixteen of sixteen programs. Same-policy mapping-reversed donors preserved fourteen. No individual neuron meaning or coding improvement established.
